regions.finding: Four cited literature transformations were recorded independently: acid-catalyzed allenylindole formation, phosphine-promoted alkadiynol deoxygenation, TBAF desilylative allenol formation, and perfluoro-organocopper substitution. Visible temperatures, times, equivalents, yields, and generic substituent ranges were retained.

The prose identifies two anti-SN2-prime chiral substitution examples whose drawings and quantitative details continue on page 8; they were classified as cited literature examples, not experiments performed by the review authors.

The review prose inventories copper-catalyzed substitution, reduction, borylation, ring opening, allyl-indium, and allenylsilane examples. Successive Scheme 37 stages and distinct Scheme 39/40 condition sets were kept separate; drawings on pages 8-9 supply the visible conditions.

unresolved: Most examples are R-group series and do not support unique substrate/product SMILES.
The review does not provide original-paper scales, workups, purification details, or yield bases.

regions.finding: Schemes 35-39 were visually transcribed. Scheme 37 was split into copper-catalyzed formation of 104 and subsequent hydrolysis/Boc protection to 105. Scheme 39's general 50 °C series and the distinct 0 °C, 86 h chiral example were recorded separately.

The general copper/Xantphos borylation and its distinct chiral example were separated, followed by two cited chiral allenol substitutions. Input and product ee values, catalyst loadings, equivalents, temperatures, times, and yields were preserved where visible.
Bisepoxide and dioxolanone ring-opening examples plus allyl-indium substitution were recorded. The bracketed Scheme 44 complex was retained only as a proposed intermediate, not an isolated product.

unresolved: Scheme 35 gives no numeric yield or ee, and the general Scheme 40 series gives no numeric yield.
Generic R groups and compact stereochemical drawings remain machine-unverified.

regions.finding: Indium-mediated coupling of propargyl bromides with chlorosilanes was recorded with the visible DMF, room-temperature, 3 h conditions and 79-98% yield range; page 7 prose supplies the stated one-equivalent indium loading.

Schwartz-reagent anti-SN2-prime reductive substitution was recorded. The displayed yield/ee ranges span alternative EtMgCl versus Et2Zn/ZnCl2 and solvent choices, which remain explicitly unresolved rather than assigned to one option.

regions.region: lower-left and right-column prose introducing Schemes 48-57
regions.finding: The prose identifies Rh silylation, organozinc substitution, Ni/Fe intramolecular substitution, Rh epoxide opening, aziridine hydride migration, indium allenylations, and Cr asymmetric allenylation. These cited examples were linked to their drawings on page 10 and not treated as new experiments by the review authors.

unresolved: The original cited papers/SI were not supplied, so review-level ranges cannot be expanded into individual substrate rows or full procedures.
Scheme 47 alternatives do not map the displayed aggregate ranges to a single option.

regions.finding: Scheme 48 was split into general Rh coupling, a distinct chiral coupling, and the subsequent TiCl4-mediated aldehyde addition. Scheme 49's general and chiral examples were separated. Schemes 50-51 were recorded as cited Ni- and Fe-catalyzed intramolecular substitutions.

The two alternative Rh catalyst systems in Scheme 52 were kept as separate condition records; the displayed yield/selectivity range is explicitly marked as shared and not uniquely attributable. Scheme 53's proposed hydride-transfer structure 153 was not promoted to an isolated product.

Two indium coupling examples, the two distinct Scheme 56 electrophile branches, and chromium asymmetric allenylation were recorded. Scheme 57's acid workup remains a separate step; atmosphere and reagent loadings were structured from the arrow text.

unresolved: Scheme 49 does not display a yield for the specific 141-to-142 example.
Scheme 56 does not display numeric yields for either electrophile branch.
Scheme 52's aggregate yield/selectivity range cannot be assigned uniquely to either catalyst system.

regions.finding: The Cr/carbazole-ligand addition of bromoallenes to aldehydes was recorded with catalyst/ligand loadings, reductant/additive equivalents, THF, room temperature, 16 h, yield, and ee ranges.

Three cited intramolecular/enolate transformations were linked to page-12 drawings. The failed unprotected-enolate statement accompanying Scheme 61 was retained as a failure note and not converted into a zero-yield experiment because no complete condition set is stated.

regions.region: lower-left and right-column sections 2.4-2.5 introducing Schemes 62-70
regions.finding: Crabbe homologation and its microwave/amine/copper variants, ZnI2 disubstituted-allene synthesis, Pd/Au/Ag propargylamine variants, gold propargyl-ether conversion, and the Pd(II) nucleopalladation scheme were inventoried. Scheme 62 is a general named reaction and Scheme 70 is a mechanism, not paper-specific experiments.

unresolved: Scheme 66's 36-99% range is not assigned to one of the two catalyst systems, and Scheme 68's 63-91% range is not assigned to thermal versus microwave mode; per-condition yields remain missing.
The failed unprotected-enolate case lacks a complete independent condition set.
Most original-paper operational details remain unavailable in the review.

regions.finding: Schemes 59-61 were transcribed as cited literature examples; Scheme 62 was classified as a general Crabbe homologation. The microwave Scheme 63 and the two distinct Scheme 64 Cu/amine condition rows were recorded independently with visible time, temperature, yield, and reagent information.

ZnI2-mediated disubstituted-allene formation and the Pd, Au, Ag, and gold(I) propargylamine/ether examples were recorded. Alternative Scheme 66 catalysts and Scheme 68 thermal/microwave programs were separated; non-attributable aggregate yield ranges remain notes with null per-condition yields.

Scheme 70 was recorded as a generic Pd(II)-initiated nucleopalladation mechanism. Proposed intermediate 2-VIV was not treated as an isolated product, and the bottom Scheme 73 lead-in was not extracted because its drawing is on page 13 outside this bounded pass.

unresolved: Scheme 66 and 68 aggregate yield ranges cannot be safely assigned to individual alternative condition records.
Scheme 73 is introduced in bottom prose but its drawing is on page 13 and was deliberately left for the next bounded pass.
Generic structures and stereochemical assignments remain machine-unverified.
